title: 窗口函数
theory:
## 窗口函数

窗口函数对一组相关的行进行计算，但不合并行（与聚合函数不同）。

### 常用函数
- `ROW_NUMBER()`, `RANK()`, `DENSE_RANK()`
- `LAG()`, `LEAD()`
- 聚合窗口: `SUM() OVER()`, `AVG() OVER()`

### 语法
```sql
function() OVER (PARTITION BY col ORDER BY col)
```
learningObjectives: 使用 ROW_NUMBER 和 RANK 排名
掌握 LAG/LEAD 同比环比
理解 PARTITION BY 分区

examples.label: 订单金额排名
examples.sql: SELECT id, amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rank FROM orders;

examples.label: 用户内订单排名
examples.sql: SELECT user_id, amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn FROM orders;

examples.label: 累计金额
examples.sql: SELECT id, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS running_total FROM orders;

initialSQL: SELECT id, amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rank FROM orders;
